label: Page — Packages
description: Session, day and project rates with booking questions.

settings.heading: Three ways to book
settings.footnote: All rates exclude travel and applicable tax. Usage is agreed in writing. Write for a proposal.

settings.name: Session
settings.for: A portrait, a room or a short editorial assignment.
settings.inclusions:
Planning call
Up to three hours photographing
Edited image selection

settings.name: Day
settings.for: Time on location, with room for the weather.
settings.inclusions:
Planning and location research
One day photographing
Edited image selection and delivery gallery

settings.name: Project
settings.for: A body of work, from the first conversation to the final sequence.
settings.inclusions:
Research and a written proposal
Agreed days photographing
Editing, sequencing and production advice
settings.note: A proposal follows our first conversation.

settings.name: Workshop
settings.for: A day in the darkroom for up to six.
settings.inclusions:
One day in the studio
Paper and printing materials
Individual print review

settings.heading: FAQs
settings.note: Write if your question is not here.

settings.question: How far ahead should I book?
settings.answer: Four to six weeks usually leaves enough time to plan. Write with your dates if the job is sooner.

settings.question: What is included in the rate?
settings.answer: Planning, the agreed time photographing, editing and a private delivery gallery. Usage, travel and print costs are listed separately in the proposal.

settings.question: Can you travel for a commission?
settings.answer: Yes. I work from Gothenburg and travel by arrangement. Travel days and expenses are agreed before the booking.
